text: Chak 104-10R (Mound Bhir) Phone: (+92) 51-9252516 Email: info@doam.gov.pk Login Home About Us ( Heritage of Pakistan Publications Projects Advertisements Resources Complaints Trainings Contact Us Chak 104-10R (Mound Bhir) Type: Archaeological Site - Settlement Province: Punjab District: Khanewal Period: Proto Historic Relative Chronology: 3500 BCE - 1800 BCE Description: An archaeological site in ruined condition with a large number of potshards scattered over the surface. The pottery collection from the site was mostly of pale red ware and included forms like water pitchers, cooking pots, dishes, bowls on disc base, flaring side and featureless rim, knobbed lids cakes, dishes on stand and perforated pot. Some glass bangles and chert blade were also recorded, a few paste beads of faience were collected along with a few fragments of shell bangles. Latitude: 30.098611111 Longitude: 71.900000000 Ownership: Private Legal Status: Not Protected Title of Publication: The Monuments and Ancient Sites in the Surveyed Districts of Punjab Published In: Pakistan Archaeology, Number 29, 1994-1996, DOAM, Karachi Year of Publication: 1996 Bibliography/Reference: Federal Department of Archaeology and Museums, Islamabad.
